name: What colors are available for sun-protection exterior paint?

mainEntity.name: What colors are available for sun-protection exterior paint?

acceptedAnswer.text: Sun-protection exterior paints are available in a wide array of colors, though lighter colors typically offer superior heat reflection compared to darker shades. Manufacturers have developed pigments that retain their sun-protective qualities across the color spectrum, allowing for both aesthetic choice and performance. When selecting a color for a sunny home in Texas, consider how the chosen hue's Light Reflectance Value (LRV) will contribute to both energy efficiency and UV resistance.
